title: CESBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Cryptographic Engineering Security for IoT Devices
abstract: arXiv:2609.21344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For Internet of Things (IoT) devices, a secure algorithm alone is not enough: an attacker with physical access can attack the implementation directly, and its flaws are hard to fix once deployed. Large language models (LLMs) are now used to build and analyze such implementations. LLM benchmarks exist for cryptography and general cybersecurity, but none covers cryptographic engineering. In this paper, we present CESBench, 380 expert-written items across six sub-domains of cryptographic engineering security for IoT devices: side-channel, fault injection, implementation, countermeasures, evaluation, and integration. Four task types target different competences: 209 multiple-choice items test recall, 67 judgment items require a security verdict and its justification, 63 scenario items require an engineering diagnosis, and 41 code tasks are graded by 572 test cases. To validate the benchmark, 11 open-weight and proprietary LLMs answer every

translated_title: CESBench：面向物联网设备密码工程安全的大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 对于物联网设备而言，仅有安全的算法是不够的：拥有物理访问权限的攻击者可以直接攻击其实现，而实现的缺陷一旦部署后便难以修复。大语言模型目前已被用于构建和分析此类实现。现有的大语言模型基准覆盖了密码学和一般网络安全领域，但尚无基准涵盖密码工程。本文提出了CESBench，包含380道由专家撰写的题目，涵盖物联网设备密码工程安全的六个子领域：侧信道攻击、故障注入、实现、防护对策、评估与集成。四种任务类型针对不同能力：209道多选题测试知识记忆能力，67道判断题要求给出安全判定及其理由，63道场景题要求进行工程诊断，41道代码任务由572个测试用例进行评分。为验证该基准的有效性，11个开放权重及专有大语言模型回答了每一道题目。
tldr: 本文提出了首个面向物联网设备密码工程安全的大语言模型基准CESBench，包含380道专家撰写的题目，通过多选题、判断题、场景题和代码任务四种任务类型，系统评估大语言模型在侧信道、故障注入等六个密码工程子领域的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CESBench, the first LLM benchmark for cryptographic engineering security of IoT devices, comprising 380 expert-written items across six sub-domains (side-channel, fault injection, implementation, countermeasures, evaluation, and integration), evaluated through four task types including multiple-choice, judgment, scenario, and code tasks.
